description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2025: Measurements of Wave Characteristics for Debris Loading on Elevated Residential Structures is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sarah Wraight, University of Louisiana at Lafayette (louisiana.edu). Debris loading experiments with various wave- current conditions were conducted in the U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI) Large Wave Flume at the O.H. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-bne7-8386. Keywords:  NSF NHERI,  O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory,  Debris Loading,  Wave Measurements, Elevated Coastal Structures. Published 2025-08-21. Facility named: Large Wave Flume and Directional Wave Basin - Oregon State University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
